Mandya.desc: Mandya is a city, also taluka in the state of Karnataka. It is the headquarters of Mandya district. It is also called Sugar City because sugarcane is a major crop grown here, and sugar factories contribute to the major economic output. The district o

Srirangapatna.desc: Srirangapatna is an island town on the Kaveri River near Mysore, famous for the Ranganathaswamy Temple and the 1799 siege site of Tipu Sultan's capital. It is a mandatory stop on the Bengaluru–Mysore highway road trip, ~15 km before Mysore. (sourced from BLR-Mysore road trip posts)

Ranganathittu.desc: Located about 20 km from Mysuru, Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary is a haven for birdwatchers, home to a variety of migratory and resident bird species. Boat rides along the river offer excellent opportunities to observe the birds in their natural habitat. (sourced from r/travel Top 10 Places in Mysuru)
